about_the_game:
Become a Visual Novel Creator  
  
NovelStudio is an all-in-one editor designed to bring your interactive stories to life. No technical skills required. Whether you're a writer, game designer, or simply passionate about storytelling, become a Visual Novel producer. Characters, backgrounds, dialogues, mechanics. Everything you need to express your creativity is included.  
   

Customizable 2D animated characters    
Create your own characters in just a few clicks with a variety of facial expressions, outfits, and poses. You can also import your own artwork or custom 3D models.
   

Design your own backgrounds   
Easily craft classic visual novel settings or import your own images for a more personal visual style.
   

Build your story without coding   
Create your story’s structure using an intuitive system of narrative blocks. Each block contains a scene with backgrounds, characters, dialogue, interactive choices, and audio files.
   

Add gameplay and depth   
Use variables to create gauges, manage money, track relationships, or influence the story. Add modifiers to build complex systems, all without writing a single line of code.
   

Create playable levels   
With its built-in 3D map editor, Novel Studio even lets you design interactive environments with playable characters and ready-to-use assets.
